providers.name: Dr. William Donovan
providers.imageAlt: Dr. William Donovan with his family and dog outdoors.
providers.summary: A Navy-trained dentist whose career has combined advanced general-dentistry education, service, and long-standing ties to Beaufort.
details: Dr. Donovan graduated from Presbyterian College and attended dental school at the Medical College of Georgia. Before dental school, he worked as a dental laboratory technician, experience that shaped his attention to restorative detail.
He served as a U.S. Navy Dental Officer, completed an Advanced Education in General Dentistry residency, and later made Beaufort home after being stationed at MCRD Parris Island.
Outside the practice, Dr. Donovan and his family enjoy traveling, spending time outdoors, and participating in the Beaufort community.

providers.name: Dr. Caroline Whitaker
providers.summary: A thoughtful general dentist focused on comfortable visits, clear explanations, and practical treatment planning for patients of all ages.
details: Dr. Whitaker brings an approachable, prevention-minded style to family dentistry and enjoys helping patients understand their options before deciding on care.
Her interests include restorative dentistry, cosmetic improvements, and helping anxious patients feel more at ease throughout their visit.
She and her family enjoy the waterways, trails, and community traditions that make the Lowcountry feel like home.
